# Price book 2026 (internal)

Standard: $52.00 per seat per month, list.
Plus: $68.00 per seat per month, list.
Floor price, Standard: $38.00 per seat per month. Never quote below the floor.

# Discount approval matrix (internal)

Up to 10% off list: account executive.
11% to 25%: sales manager approval in the deal desk.
Over 25%: VP approval in the deal desk. No verbal approvals.
